Plant Care Specialists are available **9am–5pm Mon–Fri only** — unfortunately not on Sundays. Your next available window is Monday morning.

In the meantime, here's the most common fix: ZZ plants often droop from **overwatering**. Check if the top inch of soil is dry before watering next time. Also ensure it has indirect light and isn't in a cold draft.

You can also **email help@leafy.example** anytime (answered within 1 business day) or chat with our general team **8am–8pm Sat–Sun** if you need immediate guidance. Would either of those work for you?
